newsitem.title: CHINA: China says work on nuclear plant moving ahead.
newsitem.headline: China says work on nuclear plant moving ahead.

text.p: Construction on the early phase on the Lingao nuclear power plant in southern China's Guangdong province is proceeding smoothly, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Workers had started to pour cement for the foundation of one of the plant's reactors and had begun building embankments to protect against ocean waves, Xinhua said.
Construction crews had moved some six million cubic metres of earth and had built a reservoir holding more than 500,000 cubic metres of water, the agency said.
The plant, one km (0.6 miles) from the already operational Daya Bay nuclear plant, would have two 900-megawatt generating units on completion in 2000. Work began last July.
The plant would be financed with foreign capital, it said without giving further details.
